open_obligations.what_is_open: Construct a nonempty open semialgebraic region in the \(\lambda\)--\(\alpha\) plane on which one specified balanced \(m=2\) binary partition is globally optimal over every common private channel and confidence rule, and continue an attaining certificate to an algebraically isolated transverse frontier with a strict adjacent nonbinary separation.
open_obligations.obstruction: The available unrestricted certificate is not optimizer-attaining: at \(\lambda=1000\) and \(\alpha=2/5\) its certified lower and feasible upper values differ by \(297/50000000\), while the entire interval \([999.9,1000.1]\) is already certified to lie outside \(\mathcal B_{4,2/5}\). Fixed-binary confidence duals at \(\lambda=2,3,10,100\) leave nonzero global polarization gaps, so fixed-channel optimality does not furnish the simultaneous lower saddle required by \(\Gamma_J\). Semialgebraicity alone gives only a finite list of possible contacts and does not prove that an equality cell is nonempty or select a frontier polynomial.
open_obligations.attempted: Reused the exact fixed-channel primal--dual extractions, the full fourteen-weight channel representation, all \(41^4=2825761\) polarized vertex-tensor bounds at the certified point, the robust dual refinement, the balanced-binary duals at four additional privacy budgets, and the established certificate-characterization theorem. I also audited the supplied exact certificate payloads for a matching binary primal/global-dual value or a recorded continuing active set; none is present. Because every available simultaneous lower bound remains strict at its proposed binary candidate, there is no equality identity to continue and hence no honest endpoint polynomial, isolating interval, sign pair, or active-set-change event to report.
open_obligations.partial_result:
At \(N=4\), \(\alpha=2/5\), and \(\lambda=1000\), the exact certificates prove
\[
\frac{129113957}{50000000}
\le L^\star_{4,2/5}(1000)
\le \frac{64557127}{25000000},
\]
whose width is \(297/50000000\).  They also prove that every optimizer uses \(m=2\) at this point, that every optimizer uses \(m=2\) for \(\lambda\ge1000\) when \(\alpha=2/5\), and that
\[
[999.9,1000.1]\cap\mathcal B_{4,2/5}=\varnothing.
\]
The semialgebraic characterization reduces any future certified boundary to finitely many basis-determinant, inactive-slack, residual-contact, or candidate-value-difference polynomial contacts.  None of the checked certificates attains the unrestricted optimum at a balanced binary channel, so these results neither exhibit a nonempty equality cell nor locate one of its boundary points.

prose_updates.tldr: Exact finite-population SATE inference under local privacy reduces to a fourteen-pattern, degree-\(N\) polynomial channel game with an inner exact confidence linear program. At \(N=4\), \(\alpha=2/5\), and \(\lambda=1000\), rational certificates bracket the unrestricted optimum within \(5.94\times10^{-6}\), force balanced allocation for every \(\lambda\ge1000\), and prove that four-ary response strictly beats every balanced binary-partition response throughout \([999.9,1000.1]\). No optimizer-attaining balanced-binary cell or actual equality-set boundary is established.

project_justification.fill: The project supplies a lossless schedule-orbit reduction, an explicit fourteen-output Blackwell refinement, exact fixed-channel primal--dual confidence inference, an attained degree-\(N\) polynomial formulation, a global polynomial-dual certificate method, a certified nonbinary interval, and a balanced-allocation theorem for the stated four-unit regime. It does not claim the previously proposed balanced-binary phase boundary, whose optimizer-attaining certificate remains open.

prose_updates.related_work: Kairouz, Oh, and Viswanath (2016), Section 7 and Lemma 22, provide the cube decomposition underlying the staircase factorization of a pure locally private column. The present reduction uses that geometric basis and adds the problem-specific strengthening: it explicitly absorbs the constant ray into complementary nonconstant patterns, normalizes the resulting fourteen weights, extracts an input-independent postprocessing kernel, and thereby obtains Blackwell dominance for the entire finite-population confidence game. Their convex-utility output-size conclusions do not apply because the optimized product-channel confidence utility is not convex in the required direction. Ohnishi and Awan (2025) study locally private causal inference for a superpopulation PATE under Bernoulli treatment and asymptotic estimation or inference; the present target is the fixed-population SATE under complete randomization with a hidden assignment. Rigdon and Hudgens (2015) treat exact finite-population SATE inference without this local channel-design game. Schafer and Stark (2009) motivate least-favorable-prior confidence optimization for a fixed experiment. Chen, Cormode, Bharadwaj, Romov, and Ozgur (2024) optimize distributed-private mechanisms and allocation but do not derive this schedulewise exact common-channel game or its boundaries. Ghazi, Nasser, Calmon, and Issa (2026) obtain partition mechanisms for simple binary testing, whereas the current confidence problem has many schedule nulls and no single likelihood-ratio ordering.
prose_updates.interpretation: The two-parameter equality locus consists of pairs \((\lambda,\alpha)\) satisfying \(\lambda\in\mathcal B_{N,\alpha}\). For a fixed \(\alpha\), the set \(\mathcal B_{N,\alpha}\subset(1,\infty)\) is only the horizontal section of that locus, and an endpoint is a one-dimensional section boundary. A two-dimensional optimizer cell would have to be proved before a transverse fixed-\(\alpha\) root could be called an actual phase boundary. The current certificates instead identify a two-sided exclusion interval in one fixed section.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The exact unrestricted lower certificate at \((N,\alpha,\lambda)=(4,2/5,1000)\) misses the feasible upper value by \(297/50000000\). This positive slack is small enough for the stated value bracket but prevents identification of a minimizing channel. The checked balanced-binary fixed-channel duals also fail to yield a matching lower bound over the full staircase polytope. Consequently there is no equality identity to continue, and no certified two-dimensional cell, frontier polynomial, isolating interval, sign change of \(\Delta_{4,\alpha}(\lambda)\), or channel-support or confidence-basis transition has been obtained.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The proved contribution consists of the exact orbit kernel, fourteen-output Blackwell refinement, fixed-channel primal--dual program, attained polynomial formulation, nonconvexity witness, global positive-tolerance bracket, balanced-allocation result for \(N=4\), \(\alpha=2/5\), and \(\lambda\ge1000\), and the nonbinary exclusion interval \([999.9,1000.1]\). The certificate-characterization theorem remains conditional: it explains how an explicitly supplied attaining family would certify a cell and boundary, but no such family is supplied. In particular, the paper does not claim a nonempty balanced-binary equality cell, an endpoint polynomial, an isolated root, a sign-certified phase transition, four-output sufficiency, general-\(N\) balance, or a practical advantage at conventional coverage. Consumer use requires a hidden-assignment protocol in which the analyst observes only privatized reports and the known design quantities.

statement_notes.justification: This node is retained as the exact unresolved structural question whose solution would be needed before advertising a balanced-binary phase boundary.
statement_notes.gap: No optimizer-attaining global certificate, nonempty equality cell, frontier polynomial, transverse root, adjacent sign pair, or active-set transition has been proved from the frozen primitives and exact artifacts.
statement_notes.consumer: Only a future resolution could yield a certified switch point between one-bit and richer hidden-assignment reporting protocols; the current results provide an exclusion interval, not such a threshold.
